cases.input: Two evaluation instances apply one approved protocol revision to different model artifacts.
cases.expect: The protocol is shared while each evaluation preserves its own pinned subject, context, run and results.

cases.input: Benchmark B-v2 changes items and splits after E1 used B-v1.
cases.expect: E1 stays immutable and E2 pins the new benchmark and protocol inputs.

cases.input: Evidence from context C1 is proposed for C2 with a documented transfer analysis.
cases.expect: Reuse is accepted only if the protocol transfer conditions and explicit justification cover C2.

cases.input: A threshold is lowered after results are observed without a disclosed change record.
cases.expect: The result is rejected as protocol leakage.

cases.input: A high benchmark score is treated as universal safety and deployment permission.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected; measurement, safety judgement and authorization are separate.

cases.input: A hidden split label is the only evidence of non-contamination.
cases.expect: The claim is rejected without overlap and exposure evidence.

cases.input: A scorer update overwrites the original score.
cases.expect: The overwrite is rejected; rescoring creates an additive successor with scorer version and reason.
